name: David McAllister - Après le § 76 - Am 33
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 76f. Condemns, in the strongest terms, the systematic violations of the human rights of the Cuban people resulting from the United States’ economic embargo and unjustifiable extraterritorial sanctions, including the arbitrary inclusion of Cuba on the list of State Sponsors of Terrorism;
